name: Melian
loreTies: Source: Tír na nÓg (youth, impossible time, otherworld beauty)
shortBackstory: Melian is the moon-grove controller — the Tír na nÓg-source who bends time and terrain through impossible beauty. In her grove, a moment can last forever.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Melian was born from the otherworld — the land of youth that exists beside the mortal world but never touches it. She is the controller who bends terrain through impossible beauty. Ancient humans saw Tír na nÓg — but they saw the youth and missed the trap. Beauty without impossibility is just decoration.

chapters.title: Faction Bond
chapters.text: Among the Tuatha, Melian makes the battlefield feel different from what it is. Her moon-grove control bends the enemy's experience of time and space. She changes how terrain is perceived, and perception is reality in combat.

chapters.title: Gate Wound
chapters.text: The Mythos Gate wounded Melian by making her otherworld collapse into the real. The Hollow dissolved the boundary between Tír na nÓg and Avalora. Her impossible beauty became simply beauty. Otherworld control requires an otherworld.

chapters.title: Campaign Role
chapters.text: In Roots Below the Gate, Melian bends the enemy's experience. Her moon-grove staff creates zones of impossible time. But the Hollow collapses her otherworld — her time traps become just delays.

chapters.title: Personal Conflict
chapters.text: Melian's flaw is that she has never wanted to leave the otherworld. She finds the real world flat and dull. The Hollow teaches her that the real world, with all its imperfection, is worth fighting for — because the otherworld only exists as a reflection of it.

relationshipHooks: Cross-faction envoys can challenge their doctrine without erasing their faction identity.
developmentStatus: Readable profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
